# Contributing

All changes must go through a pull request.

PRs must include:

- A filled-in title and description
- Accurate labels
- A passing HOOTL test
- Review before merge

For help, please contact the person in charge of the firmware via Discord, preferably through a channel and not as a direct message. Alternatively, you can ask your team lead for assistance.

See other relevant documentation by searching for other markdown files within this repository.
